messages:
sam.green: Heads up — deploy-bot just flagged a canary p95 latency spike after the 2.6.0 rollout. Not seeing an automated revert. Anyone watching?

deploy-bot: ALERT: canary_deploy /inference-api v2.6.0 -> p95 420ms (+180ms vs baseline), errors 0.9% (+0.7%). Auto-rollback conditions not met: sustained window 3m required.

jordan: I can see error-rate correlated with kv-cache evictions on the canary pool. Tail requests hitting quantized kernel path causing GC/stalls.

marta_oncall: Oncall here — if it stays +150ms p95 for another 2m I'll trigger manual rollback. Proposing pin to v2.5.3 for production while we debug. Anyone object?

ryan: No objection from infra. We should also reduce canary traffic to 0% first before full rollback to avoid compounding load.

ciara: I'll draft the rollback blurb for release notes and update the changelog. Adding incident tag and linking nightly evals.

release-manager: Confirmed we will notify Dedicated customers on the incident channel once pinned. ETA for manual action?

marta_oncall: Executing steps in runbook now. Will update when traffic split changes.

```
# runbook excerpt - manual pin + rollback
deployctl traffic set --service inference-api --canary 0
deployctl pin --service inference-api --version 2.5.3 --reason "canary p95 regression"
deployctl rollback --service inference-api --from 2.6.0 --to 2.5.3 --mode manual
```

marta_oncall: `deployctl traffic set` returned OK. canary -> 0%.

deploy-bot: ACTION: traffic_split updated for /inference-api (canary: 0%, stable: 100%).

jordan: KV-cache eviction logs (snippet):
```
[2026-03-20T02:15:42Z] worker-7 kernel: kvcache: eviction spike, free_mem low, latency tail +190ms
[2026-03-20T02:16:01Z] runtime: quant-kernel fallback activated for batch sizes > 64
```

marta_oncall: Pin completed and rollback initiated. Rolling back canary instances to 2.5.3 and draining new pods.

ryan: Monitoring metrics — p95 trending back to baseline within 30s. No increase in errors after traffic shift.

ciara: Release notes draft: "Hot rollback: reverted inference-api to v2.5.3 due to observed p95 latency regression in 2.6.0 canary. Root cause: kv-cache eviction patterns interacting with new kernel scheduling under certain batch sizes. Investigation ongoing." Will post PR to docs.

sam.green: Nice quick ops. Please add the repro prompt set and perf traces to the incident card. We'll schedule a follow-up postmortem and decide on a targeted re-roll with kernel flag gated behind a canary of 1% first.

release-manager: Customer comms prepared and queued. Sending to accounts with Dedicated SLAs now.

marta_oncall: All done — rollback complete, canary 0%, stable 100% on v2.5.3. Marking as mitigated. :white_check_mark:

sam.green: :thumbsup: I'll update the rollout tracker and assign follow-ups. Thanks team.
